Hi Maya,

Thanks for the heads-up on the renewal window. Per our conversation last week, Helio is evaluating a +40% committed capacity uplift for calendar Q4 — happy to support that and propose a 12-month term amendment to lock pricing.

Before I draft the formal amendment, quick questions so we can align with your procurement team:
- Do you require a staged PO (initial uplift + follow-on top-up) or a single PO for the full commit?
- Is there a vendor onboarding refresh in your procurement portal (e.g., new paperwork, updated bank details, updated W-9) that we should plan for?
- Any security artifacts you need up front (SOC 2, encryption attestation, subprocessor list)?

I can pull together: amendment + short SOW for the capacity increase, a PO template for Helio, and our latest SOC2 Type II. Looping in Laura to help with contract questions.

Proposed next step: 30-min procurement sync this week to confirm preferred PO flow and timelines. What times work for your procurement lead?

Thanks — Jordan

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the quick follow-up. A few clarifications from procurement: 

- We prefer a two-stage PO for this engagement: an initial PO to cover the Q4 uplift (effective immediately) and a cancellable follow-on PO for the remaining commit to be executed after we complete an internal budget approval on Oct 15.
- Our vendor portal has a refreshed onboarding step this year: we need current SOC2, bank routing verification (ACH form), and an updated contract signature page. There is a short online profile to fill out as well.
- Please include a redlined amendment showing term changes and the new committed token/hour tiers.

I've added procurement@heliotherapeutics.com — that team will own the PO. Can your legal/finance contact send the SOC2 and the PO template so procurement can pre-check before we schedule signatures?

Suggested times for sync: Wed 9/6 between 10:00–12:00 ET or Thu 9/7 after 13:00 ET.

Best,
Maya
